description: This file defines the ProductController class implementing API endpoints for product creation, order creation, order status retrieval, and product listing in a Node.js e-commerce microservice.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: Controller class providing API methods for product and order management.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates a new product after validating request and authorization.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates an order, publishes message to message broker, and polls for completion.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of an existing order by order ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves list of all products after authorization.
